Look4Sat-BA7OPF is a customized fork of Look4Sat. All upstream features, plus:
Satellite logbook — one-tap logging of callsign, time, frequency, mode, report and grid.
Direct LoTW upload — import your ARRL certificate and upload logs to LoTW right from the app, no PC needed.
Confirmation sync — one-tap sync of LoTW confirmations, marked as uploaded/confirmed. Editing an uploaded entry creates a new one, leaving the original untouched.
How: tap Record after a QSO → Upload on the log page → Sync in Settings.
Enter your QTH and a friend\'s to find passes visible to both; tap a pass to open the radar.
How: Match tab → set both stations → Query.
Grids synced from LoTW/Wavelog shown in green, with award boundaries and first-QSO callsign labels; tap a grid to see its QSOs and match a friend.
How: enable Grid mode on the map → sync LoTW/Wavelog in Settings.

IC-820: CI-V 0x42, 1200 baud (8N1). Frequency and LSB/USB/CW/FM control with main/sub band access. CAT PTT, CAT CTCSS, DATA and automatic single-radio satellite setup are not supported. For receive-only tracking, configure only the RX connection; use separate radios for dual-radio tracking. Configure satellite mode and tone on the radio itself.
